strict_test_acquisition_contract.slot_a: New underground world family not present in this repository or historical results; freeze asset hash before any V3 model sees it.
strict_test_acquisition_contract.slot_b: A second geometry-family-disjoint underground world, acquired or generated independently from slot A.
strict_test_acquisition_contract.isolation: Encrypted/separate manifest or access-controlled path until final evaluation; no screenshots, teacher outputs, metrics or trajectories used for development.

protocol.evaluation_start: First robot displacement >=0.5 m after planner-ready evidence; if no such movement occurs within 60 s, mark INVALID_NO_MOTION rather than shifting the window indefinitely.
protocol.planner_ready_evidence: First valid /way_point plus synchronized /registered_scan and /state_estimation_at_scan after all required nodes are alive.

seed_control.blocker: vehicle_simulator.launch does not expose a seed; LiDAR uses nonzero Gaussian noise and rand(), while TARE also uses std::random_device/rand(). Logical repeat IDs are not equivalent to controlled seeds.
seed_control.required_fix_before_runs: Add and verify one deterministic seed mechanism covering Gazebo, sensor noise and TARE/replacement stochastic components; then freeze five concrete seed values and pair both methods by seed.

frozen_common_stack_candidate.sensor: M-TARE simulated LiDAR with parameters hashed in run manifest
frozen_common_stack_candidate.global_planner_difference_only: tare_planner_node versus V3 semantic-topological global planner

primary.name: reference_surface_coverage_fraction_over_time
primary.definition: Cumulative unique 0.5 m reference-surface voxels directly observed by LiDAR divided by deterministic reachable reference-surface voxels for that world.
primary.why: Produces a world-normalized coverage-time curve rather than counting trajectory cells or raw messages.
primary.unresolved: Reference-surface and reachable-mask generator does not yet exist and must be audited against each world before freeze.

primary.name: normalized_coverage_auc_600s
primary.definition: Time integral of reference_surface_coverage_fraction over 600 s divided by 600 s.
primary.why: Rewards early exploration while remaining comparable within each world.

secondary: unique_2m_trajectory_cells and revisit_fraction as navigation diagnostics, not primary coverage
stuck_count, local_rejection_count, recovery_count and invalid-run reason
global planning runtime p50/p95/max and missed-deadline fraction
semantic-topology nodes/edges, connected components, duplicate-node rate and traversable-edge preservation
metrics.historical_metric_limit: learning/structural_learning/tools/analyze_exploration_bag.py counts observed scan cells and trajectory cells without a reachable-world denominator. It is useful for diagnostics but is not yet the frozen primary coverage metric.
metrics.aggregation: Report every run, per-world paired-seed differences, mean/std and median/IQR. Never pool cells across worlds with different geometry sizes.
visualizations: Per-world coverage-time curves with all five runs faint and aggregate curve prominent
Trajectory over world reference map for every INVALID or worst-quartile run
Failure timeline aligning waypoint, local path, command, rejection/recovery and odometry
Topology overlay only when paired with machine-readable graph and error categories

invalid_run_rules: INVALID_NODE_FAILURE: any required simulator, terrain, local planner, controller or active global planner node exits.
INVALID_NO_MOTION: no 0.5 m displacement within 60 s after planner ready.
INVALID_TOPIC_GAP: required sensor/pose stream is absent or has an unexplained gap >5 s.
INVALID_INTERFACE: zero or multiple active /way_point publishers, wrong message type/frame, or missing local /path and /cmd_vel chain.
INVALID_COLLISION_OR_SPAWN: robot starts in collision, outside reachable geometry, falls, or spawn adjustment differs between methods.
INVALID_LOG: required bag, exact config/hash manifest, node health, waypoint/path/cmd/recovery topics or final summary is missing.
Planner failure with a healthy common stack is a valid poor outcome, not an INVALID run; the reason must distinguish system failure from method failure.
fairness_decision: Do not launch the proposed benchmark yet. First resolve seed control, reference coverage, SubTGraph spawn/no-motion, strict-test acquisition and user approval of this draft.
